description: Day-to-day OATS operation from inside an instance: home and work, modules, status and drift, spawn preview and apply (harness, relations, teams to join), soul discovery, being spawned by a trigger, retiring instances you spawned, asking for a human's attention, and saving tokens when instances message each other (who a message is for, whether to send it, how long it is); for Claude Code instances, reports when the session waits on a permission prompt or a question, or a turn ended in an API error. No layer. Workspace setup and config is oats.setup.
